minimized_witnesses.interpretation: Reduction minimizes evidence prefixes, not semantic inputs or root causes; an execution error is retained at its observed full prefix.

design.compiler_lineage: Exact TZif bytes from tagged Python tzdata 2025.2 and 2026.1-2026.5 distributions; Python tzdata release N corresponds to IANA letter release.

design.selection: Each affected zone is named in the corresponding IANA release note; pairs were fixed before scheduler outcomes were executed.

release_series.interpretation: Stepwise source-named release holdout through IANA 2026e. A release-note-supported difference is accepted only when both endpoint traces satisfy the declared contract; correlated windows are observations, not independent policy events.
